The closer of the two options is **About $8k**, though I'm not confident in it. My recollection of the Maddison Project figure is roughly $3,000–4,000 in 2011 international dollars, which is well below $8k but far above $300, and I can't check the database from here. I'd treat the $8k figure as unverified and look up the Maddison Project Database (US, 1850) before relying on it.

CONFIDENCE: 25
